title: The hidden psychology behind viral TikTok videos

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know your brain rewards TikTok like it rewards drugs?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This is why you can't stop scrolling — it's engineered to hook you.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Viral videos trigger dopamine by using short, unpredictable content.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: They often use 3-second cuts and sudden sounds to keep you engaged.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects teens and young adults, who spend 90 minutes a day on the app.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? Your brain is being tricked into wanting more.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What would you do if you knew how they're controlling your attention?

caption_text: The hidden psychology behind viral TikTok videos
